svg.title: Principle of least privilege
svg.desc: Two copies of the same thumbnail service read a booby trapped image and get hacked. On the left it has an admin role, so the attacker deletes uploads, downloads the backups and drops the users table. On the right it can only read uploads and write thumbs, so the attempts on the backups and the database are denied.

g.text: blast radius: 14 buckets and the DB

svg.text: Same bug, same attacker. The narrow role limits the damage to two buckets.
